title: Operate regulated ships only with a ship security plan
what: A regulated Australian ship must have a ship security plan in force before it operates.

laws.title: Maritime Transport and Offshore Facilities Security Act 2003

sources.title: Maritime Transport and Offshore Facilities Security Act 2003
sources.quote: 62 Offence—operating without a ship security plan (1) The ship operator for a regulated Australian ship commits an offence if: (a) the ship is being used for maritime transport; and (b) there is no ship security plan in force for the ship. Penalty: 200 penalty units.

sources.title: Maritime Transport and Offshore Facilities Security Act 2003
sources.quote: 51 Approval of maritime security plans (1) If the Secretary is satisfied that the plan adequately addresses the relevant requirements under Division 4, the Secretary must: (a) approve the plan;
